versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the check-ai-credits skill as a standalone package.
- Supports querying AI provider credits and balances for 10 services.
- Includes CLI commands for all providers, specific providers, JSON snapshots, usage trends, credential status, and per-model monthly breakdowns.
- Added extensive documentation, including SKILL.md, usage guides in README (EN and CN), and migration notes.
- Comprehensive provider and testing infrastructure established.

Initial release of check-ai-credits.

- Check AI provider credits and balances across 10 services (DeepSeek, DeepInfra, Codex, Grok, MiMo, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, OpenRouter, apikey.fun).
- Includes multiple CLI commands for full, per-provider, JSON, historical, and credential status checks.
- Supports per-model usage breakdown for DeepInfra.
- Outputs structured results with contract/schema; provides error and auth hints.
- Handles common credential and token expiry/reporting issues cleanly.
- Uses read-only credential access with no secret leaks or telemetry.
